owner.name: John Anderson
owner.tagline: I build fast, accessible digital products that feel effortless.
owner.bioShort: I'm a full-stack developer with 5+ years of experience turning complex product ideas into clear, reliable web experiences.
bioLong: With over five years of experience in web development, I've helped product teams build and scale digital experiences from first sketch to production. My work sits where thoughtful interface design meets dependable engineering.

I specialise in JavaScript technologies across the stack and have professional experience working with React, Node.js and modern cloud infrastructure. I care about the details that users feel: fast pages, obvious interactions, resilient systems and accessible flows.

footer.blurb: Building thoughtful digital products from San Francisco — for teams and ideas worth shipping.
